_doc: The ability keyword system (ROADMAP §4.2): every move = power/cost/acc + 1-2 keywords + numbers, no bespoke scripts. battle/engine.js resolves keyword semantics; this file is the design reference (names/descriptions) plus the data-driven tag chart. Move keyword params: recoil (fraction of damage dealt, self), venom (stacks added), stun/sleep (proc chance), trap/guard/priority/charge/ignoreArmor/ignoreGuard/knockback (true), accUp/accDown/powerUp/powerDown/evasionUp (stat stages, ±15%/stage), staminaRestore (flat), heal (fraction of max HP). tagChart rules: attacker move tag vs defender tag -> mult (0 = misses entirely) or rule 'ignoreArmor'.

keywords.name: Recoil
keywords.desc: The attacker takes a fraction of dealt damage. Enthusiasm has costs.

keywords.name: Venom
keywords.desc: Stacking end-of-turn damage (cap 5). Useless against machinery.

keywords.name: Stun
keywords.desc: Chance the target loses its next turn.

keywords.name: Sleep
keywords.desc: Chance the target naps until it wakes (50%/turn) or is hit.

keywords.name: Trap
keywords.desc: Target cannot switch out while the trapper stays active.

keywords.name: Guard
keywords.desc: Halves damage taken until the user's next action.

keywords.name: Charge
keywords.desc: Spends a turn winding up, hits like a freight train on the next.

keywords.name: Knockback
keywords.desc: Forces the target's side to rotate in a different fighter.

keywords.name: Stamina Restore
keywords.desc: Refills stamina. Deep breaths. Snack break.

keywords.name: Heal
keywords.desc: Restores a fraction of max HP.
